patch_description: Crossover between the simple Dijkstra baseline and the k-path load-balancing version. The current k-path version already improved total cost (1015.93 vs 1035.14), so I keep its multi-path exploration and edge-load tracking, but improve the partition assignment: instead of pure round-robin (which spreads partitions evenly across all k paths, even expensive ones), I use a weighted assignment that favors the cheapest path — the best path gets half the partitions, and the remainder are distributed over the next-best paths to balance load. I also add caching of k-shortest-path candidates per destination and safe fallback to Dijkstra on errors, ensuring the program still runs on all configs.
